related.title: NIST SP 800-61r3：分流、決策與事件交接
related.titleEn: NIST SP 800-61r3: triage, decisions and incident handoffs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付時間戳追蹤、6000筆積壓計算、回看窗測試及容量修正方案。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver timestamp traces, the six-thousand-event backlog calculation, lookback tests and a capacity correction plan.
related.difference: 分開偵測、確認、範圍判斷與遏止決策，為每步保留時間、負責人、證據與未確定事項。
related.differenceEn: Separate detection, acknowledgment, scoping and containment decisions, recording time, owner, evidence and uncertainty.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在固定速率模型中，積壓增量=(到達率−處理率)×時間；真實系統還有突發、重試與批次。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成事件以120筆/秒到達，處理100筆/秒，起始無積壓，持續300秒。 積壓=(120−100)×300=6000筆。
端到端回應時間是相鄰階段耗時之和；只縮短確認時間未必改善主要瓶頸。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成事件10:00偵測、10:08確認、10:23完成初步分流、10:50批准隔離。 各階段8、15、27分鐘，總計50分鐘；最長是決策交接27分鐘。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Under a fixed-rate model, backlog growth=(arrival−processing)×time; real systems add bursts, retries and batching. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Synthetic events arrive at 120 per second and process at 100 per second for 300 seconds from an empty queue. Backlog=(120−100)×300=6000 events.

End-to-end response time sums stage durations; faster acknowledgment may not fix the dominant bottleneck. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic event is detected at 10:00, acknowledged at 10:08, triaged at 10:23 and approved for isolation at 10:50. Stages take eight, fifteen and twenty-seven minutes, totaling fifty; decision handoff is longest.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: PostgreSQL PITR：基礎備份、WAL連續性與停止點
related.titleEn: PostgreSQL PITR: base backup, WAL continuity and recovery targets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付時間戳追蹤、6000筆積壓計算、回看窗測試及容量修正方案。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver timestamp traces, the six-thousand-event backlog calculation, lookback tests and a capacity correction plan.
related.difference: 驗證備份起點以來WAL連續性，選明確停止點並檢查應保留與應排除的交易。
related.differenceEn: Verify WAL continuity from the backup start, choose an explicit target, and test transactions that must remain or be excluded.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在固定速率模型中，積壓增量=(到達率−處理率)×時間；真實系統還有突發、重試與批次。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成事件以120筆/秒到達，處理100筆/秒，起始無積壓，持續300秒。 積壓=(120−100)×300=6000筆。
簡化復原時間=基礎備份還原時間+需重播WAL量/有效重播速率；真實時間另受I/O與檢查影響。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 假資料基礎備份還原90秒，需重播480MB WAL，有效40MB/秒。 重播12秒，簡化總時間90+12=102秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Under a fixed-rate model, backlog growth=(arrival−processing)×time; real systems add bursts, retries and batching. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Synthetic events arrive at 120 per second and process at 100 per second for 300 seconds from an empty queue. Backlog=(120−100)×300=6000 events.

Simplified recovery time is base restore plus WAL volume divided by replay rate; real timing also includes I/O and validation. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A fake-data base restore takes ninety seconds, followed by 480 MB of WAL at an effective 40 MB/s. Replay takes twelve seconds, giving a simplified total of 102 seconds.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
